p.src: A Song of Ascents. By David.

en: A Song of Ascents. By David.
u.src: A Song of Ascents. By David.

p.src: 1  I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

en: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
u.src: 1  I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

p.src: 2  Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

en: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
u.src: 2  Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

p.src: 3  Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

en: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
u.src: 3  Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

p.src: 4  where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

en: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
u.src: 4  where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

p.src: 5  For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

en: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
u.src: 5  For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

p.src: 6  Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
u.src: 6  Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

p.src: 7  Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

en: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
u.src: 7  Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

p.src: 8  For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

en: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
u.src: 8  For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

p.src: 9  For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
u.src: 9  For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
